## capsule-bookshelf-skill v0.1.5 Changelog

- 移除 skill-card.md 文件，精简冗余内容。
- 文档安全说明明确：书架生成器严格路径校验，完善目录隔离，提升安全性。
- 其余功能与主流程保持不变，无新增特性或结构调整。

- Initial public release of 胶囊书架 skill (v0.1.4).
- Input a book or author to generate capsule-style reading notes, auto-organized into a bookshelf.
- Single-page app experience: all capsules displayed, click to read, seamless navigation.
- JSON-based workflow: content extraction → JSON construction → HTML generation with Python script.
- Automatic bookshelf refresh and registration after new capsule creation.
- Output includes the capsule article link and bookshelf index for easy access.
